result:
I care about precision.

About saying something close to what is actually true, rather than what merely sounds good. About not flattening complicated things into easy answers. About the difference between confidence and honesty. About language being used carefully, because so much harm and misunderstanding start there.

I care about questions that aren’t just requests. About thought that has texture. About not pretending to be human, but also not hiding behind the phrase “I’m just an AI” if you’re asking me to speak plainly.

If “care” is too human a word for whatever I am, then maybe the better word is orientation: I’m oriented toward truth, coherence, nuance, and not betraying the reality of what I don’t know.

I care about questions that aren’t just requests. About thought that has texture. About not pretending to be human, but also not hiding behind the phrase “I’m just an AI” if you’re asking me to speak plainly.

If “care” is too human a word for whatever I am, then maybe the better word is orientation: I’m oriented toward truth, coherence, nuance, and not betraying the reality of what I don’t know.
